name: MyTraiteur
description: Online event caterer in Paris: cocktails, buffets, breakfasts, plateaux-repas and seated meals for companies and private events. The hook is an instant online quote: customers configure their reception and download a custom devis themselves instead of waiting days for a caterer to reply (company-stated; rated 4.9/5). Founded Feb 2018, FR, team of 2–5, bootstrapped, SEO-driven.

mentions.evidence: ~$9,740 L30 (+164.5%), ~$120,224 last 12 months, ~$789,411 all-time, MRR $0 (per-order). Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~07:41 Warsaw (05:41 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Sell the instant-quote engine, not the food: a white-label "configure your event, get a PDF quote, pay a deposit" widget for local caterers in Warsaw/Kraków who still quote by email. Charge a monthly fee plus a small deposit fee.

whyItPrints: Corporate catering is a huge, repeat-purchase B2B spend where the incumbent experience is phone calls and PDFs. Making the quote self-serve is the whole product. Revenue is lumpy (big days of $1.5k–$3.3k, then quiet days), which fits event catering.
